transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Can you break down the pricing plans? I want to know which one is right for a 10-person team.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Sure! Here's a quick overview:

• **Starter** – $29/month: 1 agent, 5,000 messages/month, basic analytics.
• **Pro** – $79/month: 5 agents, 50,000 messages/month, priority support, advanced analytics.
• **Business** – $199/month: 20 agents, 200,000 messages/month, dedicated success manager, custom integrations.
• **Enterprise** – Custom pricing: Unlimited agents, SLA guarantees, on-premise option.

For a 10-person team, the Business plan is likely the best fit.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Is annual billing available with a discount?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes! Annual billing saves you 20% — so the Business plan would be $159/month instead of $199 when billed yearly. That's a saving of $480 per year.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: And can we pay by invoice rather than credit card?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Invoice payment is available on the Business and Enterprise plans. Your account manager can set that up once you sign up.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great! Let us know when you're ready to get started. Have a good one!
